title: Generation-tagged handle lifetime
contract: Under generation-tagged handles, a stale handle cannot read a reallocated slot; a live matching handle returns current value.
scope: Handle/current generations 0..2, live flag; admission generation check enabled; no wraparound within model.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Admission iff live and generation matches.
Rejected handles return absent, admitted handles return value.
